name: Garlic Stir-Fry Vegetables
description: A quick, vibrant stir-fry with crisp vegetables in a savory garlic sauce.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oyster sauce (or hoisin for vegetarian)
1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water

steps.title: Prep everything first
steps.instruction: Stir-fry moves fast, so have everything ready before you start: slice all the vegetables, mince the garlic and ginger, and mix the sauce — soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil in a small bowl.

steps.title: Get the wok screaming hot
steps.instruction: Heat your wok or largest skillet over high heat until it's very hot — about 2 minutes. You want it smoking slightly. Add the vegetable oil and swirl to coat.

steps.title: Add aromatics
steps.instruction: Add the garlic and ginger. Stir constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant. Don't let it burn — this happens fast on high heat.

steps.title: Add the hard vegetables first
steps.instruction: Add the carrots and broccoli first since they take longer. Toss constantly for 2 minutes. Then add the bell pepper and snap peas and toss for another 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the sauce
steps.instruction: Pour in the sauce mixture and toss to coat everything. Then add the cornstarch slurry and keep tossing for 1 minute until the sauce thickens and coats the vegetables in a glossy glaze.

steps.title: Serve immediately
steps.instruction: Plate over steamed rice, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve right away. Stir-fry waits for no one!
